import pandas as pd

# File paths for source CSVs
source_files = [
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_33/training_0.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_33/training_1.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_33/training_2.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_33/training_3.csv",
    "autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/intermediate_space/length5_33/training_4.csv",
]

# Read all source files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
dfs = [pd.read_csv(f, index_col=0) for f in source_files]

# Concatenate (UNION) all source dataframes
df = pd.concat(dfs, ignore_index=True)

# The target schema is:
# ['GEO.id2': string, 'GEO.id': integer, 'GEO.display-label': integer, 'HD01_VD01': integer, 'HD02_VD01': integer, 'Year': integer]

# Fix column types and values:
# From source examples, GEO.id2 is numeric but target expects string
# GEO.id, GEO.display-label, HD01_VD01, HD02_VD01, Year should be integers

# Convert GEO.id2 to string
df['GEO.id2'] = df['GEO.id2'].astype(str)

# Convert other columns to integers, handling floats by rounding or converting safely
for col in ['GEO.id', 'GEO.display-label', 'HD01_VD01', 'HD02_VD01', 'Year']:
    # Some columns may have float values, convert to int safely
    df[col] = pd.to_numeric(df[col], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Reorder columns to match target schema exactly
df = df[['GEO.id2', 'GEO.id', 'GEO.display-label', 'HD01_VD01', 'HD02_VD01', 'Year']]

# Write the final dataframe to the target CSV path without the index
df.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/target_multisource.csv", index=False)

import pandas as pd

# Read source CSV files with index_col=0 to ignore the numerical index column
source0 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/training_0.csv", index_col=0)
source1 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/training_1.csv", index_col=0)
source2 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/training_2.csv", index_col=0)
source3 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/training_3.csv", index_col=0)
source4 = pd.read_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/training_4.csv", index_col=0)

# Convert columns to consistent types before join to avoid float issues
for df in [source0, source1, source2, source3, source4]:
    df['GEO.id2'] = df['GEO.id2'].astype(str)
    df['GEO.id'] = pd.to_numeric(df['GEO.id'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['GEO.display-label'] = pd.to_numeric(df['GEO.display-label'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['HD01_VD01'] = pd.to_numeric(df['HD01_VD01'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['HD02_VD01'] = pd.to_numeric(df['HD02_VD01'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)
    df['Year'] = pd.to_numeric(df['Year'], errors='coerce').fillna(0).astype(int)

# Start with source0 as base
df = source0

# Join source1 on GEO.id2
df = df.merge(source1, on='GEO.id2', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_1'))

# Join source2 on GEO.id2
df = df.merge(source2, on='GEO.id2', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_2'))

# Join source3 on GEO.id2
df = df.merge(source3, on='GEO.id2', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_3'))

# Join source4 on GEO.id2
df = df.merge(source4, on='GEO.id2', how='inner', suffixes=('', '_4'))

# Aggregate columns by summing HD01_VD01 and HD02_VD01 from all sources,
# and taking max for Year, GEO.id, GEO.display-label (assuming these are consistent or max is safe)
df['HD01_VD01'] = (
    df['HD01_VD01'] + df['HD01_VD01_1'] + df['HD01_VD01_2'] + df['HD01_VD01_3'] + df['HD01_VD01_4']
)
df['HD02_VD01'] = (
    df['HD02_VD01'] + df['HD02_VD01_1'] + df['HD02_VD01_2'] + df['HD02_VD01_3'] + df['HD02_VD01_4']
)
df['Year'] = df[['Year', 'Year_1', 'Year_2', 'Year_3', 'Year_4']].max(axis=1)
df['GEO.id'] = df[['GEO.id', 'GEO.id_1', 'GEO.id_2', 'GEO.id_3', 'GEO.id_4']].max(axis=1)
df['GEO.display-label'] = df[['GEO.display-label', 'GEO.display-label_1', 'GEO.display-label_2', 'GEO.display-label_3', 'GEO.display-label_4']].max(axis=1)

# Select only the target columns
result = df[['GEO.id2', 'GEO.id', 'GEO.display-label', 'HD01_VD01', 'HD02_VD01', 'Year']]

# Group by GEO.id2 to ensure uniqueness and aggregate sums/max as above
result = result.groupby('GEO.id2', as_index=False).agg({
    'GEO.id': 'max',
    'GEO.display-label': 'max',
    'HD01_VD01': 'sum',
    'HD02_VD01': 'sum',
    'Year': 'max'
})

# Write to output CSV
result.to_csv("autopipeline-benchmarks/github-pipelines/length5_33/target_multisource_critique_history.csv", index=False)
